mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, customer_name, customer_phone, customer_address, product_type, product_spec, product_num, unit_price, total_price, remark, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_order WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_order SET status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM sys_order WHERE status = #{status}
